decisions.reason: The position specifies a new physical privacy panel for the WC partition system.

items.material_name: 40 × 90 cm melamine-faced solid particleboard WC privacy panel, >30 mm, RAL 7015 or equivalent
items.description: ABS-edged panel with E6/EV1 anodized aluminum profiles, 15 cm floor clearance, and 2.15 m overall height.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new physical privacy screen with support feet.

items.material_name: 100 × 200 cm melamine-faced solid particleboard WC privacy screen with feet, >30 mm, RAL 7015 or equivalent
items.description: ABS-edged screen with E6/EV1 anodized aluminum profiles, 15 cm floor clearance, and 2.15 m overall height.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new physical shower partition with feet and fittings, even though it is optional.

items.material_name: T-shaped waterproof compact HPL shower partition with feet, 90 × 200 cm with 60 × 200 cm return, >25 mm, RAL 7015 or equivalent
items.description: Textured matte panels with colored ABS edging and E6/EV1 anodized aluminum profiles; 15 cm floor clearance.

decisions.reason: The position covers fitting the specified WC partition around building projections and recesses without specifying a separate new product.
The position specifies a new physical finger guard for the WC partition door.

items.material_name: Full-height hinge-side finger guard for 2.00 m WC partition door
items.description: Protects against finger pinching along the entire hinge side of the door.
